description: EIP-2930 Transaction (Type 1) - Transaction with Access List
source: alloy-rs signer-ledger test vector (Ledger Ethereum app example)
notes: EIP-2930 introduced in Berlin hard fork
Access list declares addresses and storage slots for gas optimization
Pre-warming storage reduces gas costs for SLOAD and other opcodes
Access list contains 1 address with 2 storage keys
Includes contract call data (not a simple transfer)
